Apple M6

The Apple M6 is an ARM-based system on a chip created by Apple Inc., part of the Apple silicon family. It was announced on August 25, 2026, succeeding the Apple M5, and it was released on September 22, 2026. Each chip integrates a central processing unit, graphics processing unit, neural processing unit, and unified memory in a single package. The M6 is the first Apple silicon chip to be manufactured using TSMC's 2 nm process. More at Wikipedia
